title: Repeatable Plant Phenotyping Field Workbook
purpose: Teach repeatable botanical measurement and distinguish raw observations from causal interpretation.

sections.title: Operational Measurement Definitions
qualityRules: Define landmarks and position before measuring.
Preserve each repeated reading, not only the arithmetic mean.
Do not report precision beyond calibration and positioning uncertainty.
sections.decisionPrompt: Could another observer reproduce each measurement using the recorded protocol?

sections.title: Image and Context Metadata
sections.decisionPrompt: Could another reviewer reconstruct how this photograph was produced?

sections.title: Evidence and Interpretation
qualityRules: Repeated readings from one plant are technical repeats, not independent biological replicates.
Photographic appearance cannot establish chemical concentration.
Correlation does not establish a causal treatment effect.
sections.decisionPrompt: Is the conclusion limited to what the sampling and measurement design can support?

qualityRules: Use missing/not applicable/not measurable rather than replacing missing values with zero.
Never overwrite raw data when correcting interpretation.
Retain original photographs and record operational definitions.
The companion markdown workbook is editorial draft only; it does not imply scientific approval.
